fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not specify assignment vertices, clause-dependent lattices, centers, shell radius, or the asymmetric lamination. Enumerating small bases could test O14 realizability, but even a pass would not test the claimed O10/O13 excess multiplication and therefore is not genuinely discriminating for the mechanism.

Proposal 2 never emits the nine-clause lattice, target, scaling, or consistency construction, and it switches between Construction-D and Construction-A. O5/O7 remain fatal: if a harmful affine point occupies an honest coset, that coset's short honest leader defeats any lower bound on illegal coset leaders; DROP survival and concatenation growth are also unproved.

Proposal 3 leaves the incidence complex, mapping cone, cover, and coordinate embedding undefined. Primitive penalties do nothing when the G13 affine lift maps to the zero chain, while one double cover cannot establish the O10/O13 claim that adverse Hodge energy grows faster than honest energy.

Proposal 4 assumes the metric confines every unrestricted lattice point in the relevant shell to one sign chamber, which is exactly the missing O19 premise. Rank-4/5 represented matroids have circuits of size at most 5/6, so the proposed search cannot discriminate the claimed asymptotic high-girth cost, and neither harmfulness nor the perturbation family is finitely specified.

Proposal 5 has no additive CVP realization of ideal multiplication; externally checking multiplication would violate O3, while linearizing it reopens O5/O7/O16/O20. A class-number-two example cannot test tower growth, and nonprincipality alone supplies no large Euclidean minimum or equal honest radius.

Proposal 6 does not specify the repaired asymmetric seed, parity-check search range, emitted factor, target, or a complete shell bound. Linear rank-code checks cannot assume honest rank-one structure against unrestricted entangled coefficient matrices (O12), and enumeration restricted to l1<=4 cannot certify exact CVP distance or strict O13 superadditivity.

Proposal 7 conflates sandpile stabilization with unrestricted Euclidean nearest-vector selection; recurrent or superstable status is an impermissible external filter unless proved to coincide with the emitted CVP optimum. Laplacian cosets remain additive, so O5/O7 affine collisions can occupy the same short class, and the chip map, target, equal-radius completeness, and attachment construction are unspecified.
evidence: No verifier, emitted basis, target, exact control minimum, or exhaustive shell certificate is supplied for any proposal. All claimed expected moves are therefore unsupported.

G13 found an exact harmful affine combination annihilating every compatible linear syndrome, and G15 lifted it through an entire hierarchy with zero residual. This directly blocks the code, mapping-cone, ideal-linearization, rank-check, and sandpile-coset proposals absent a proved nonlinear escape.

G28 measured adverse growth below legal growth, and G32 exhibited exactly additive cross-copy parity. Thus no proposal may assume lamination, concatenation, covers, matroid girth, towers, or graph lifts provide O10/O13 growth.

G30 showed unrestricted tensor coefficients invalidate intended rank-one reasoning, while G19 found a signed accepting flow despite complete linear constraints. These results directly undermine Proposals 6 and 7.
G33/G34 failed exact common-sphere and positive-metric completeness gates. Proposal 1 and every other geometric construction likewise require a fully specified O14 gate before any soundness search.
